text:
nina_sales: Urgent - Globex POC demo just hit a bunch of 5xx/503s while we were ramping queries during the pricing Q&A. Customer paused. Pinging @alan_se and @mike_sre for triage.

alan_se: On it. Can you paste a failing request id and a minimal request/response so I can map to traces?

nina_sales: Example from attendee machine (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize"}]}'
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< x-request-id: greq_777
< x-error-code: capacity_throttle
{"error":"service overloaded: throttle, queue_len=210"}
```

autoscale-bot: [autoscaler] pool 'poc-burst-eu' queue > 150 for 60s -> scale request delta=3, estimated new nodes healthy ~45s.

mike_sre: Looks like burst pool exhausted for EU region during a synchronized client ramp. Per-org concurrency floor hit for globex-poc-org. We also see model init latency spikes for the fp16 variant.

alan_se: Short-term options: 1) route Globex to fallback pool in eu-west1 with spare capacity, 2) failover to the smaller 'redwood-alpha-small' model, 3) increase org concurrency temporarily. Which is fastest?

jess_sales: We need to keep demo fidelity (model quality matters for pricing discussion). Prefer routing to fallback pool if perf is comparable. If we failover model, note that Globex may flag as a product risk for the deal.

rachel_sec: Quick security check: if we move to fallback pool, confirm audit logs & KMS remain customer-isolated. We have a pending security questionnaire item about where demo data flows.

mike_sre: I can flip routing to fallback-eu-2 and bump org concurrency to 60 for the next hour. Fallback pool shares the same control plane and KMS config; logs will be present in the same audit stream. I'll also pre-warm one node.

autoscale-bot: [deployment] poc-burst-eu scale 3 -> 6 requested. Health checks: 0/3 ready (starting).

nina_sales: If you flip the route now I'll update the client endpoint on the demo machine. Customer watching.

mike_sre: Route updated to fallback-eu-2 for globex-poc-org. Pre-warm done. Increased concurrency.

nina_sales: Switched endpoint locally and retried - request greq_778 returns 200 and valid text. Demo resumed and customer continues the pricing discussion. :relieved:

alan_se: Follow-ups: file ENG-POC-786 to investigate autoscale cold-starts and reduce model init variance for quantized models. Recommend adding scheduled pre-warms for calendar-blocked demos.

jess_sales: Thanks - please add a note on impact to committed throughput in the ticket so we can discuss with the procurement team.

rachel_sec: I'll update the security questionnaire response to note the temporary routing and confirm audit logs/KMS remain intact.

nina_sales: Appreciate the quick help. Will share post-demo notes with the Globex champions and ask for a scheduled pre-warm for the next exec demo. Closing thread after we attach ENG-POC-786 link. :white_check_mark:
